Account_PasskeyFailed: The passkey could not be added.
Account_PasswordBreached: Your password has appeared in a data breach. Change it below, or turn password sign-in off if you have a passkey.
Account_PasswordIsOn: You can sign in with your password.
Account_PasswordOffHint: With it off, only your passkeys, or recovery from the server, get you in.
Board_AvatarHint: A JPEG or PNG image that FitHalo shows beside the board's name.
Board_InviteHint: Use this link or QR code to invite new members to your FitHalo Scoreboard.
Board_LandingMessageHint: Leave it empty to show the default, in each visitor's language.
Board_ReplaceInviteHint: Replacing the invite code will prevent old invite links and QR codes from working.
Board_ShowInvite: Show the invite on the landing page
Details_CanApproveHint: Members allowed to approve requests can approve or decline new members from the FitHalo app.
Error_BoardNameLength: Use a name of 1 to 60 characters.
Error_BoardPasswordLength: Use a password of 8 to 256 characters.
Error_Forbidden: That request wasn't allowed. Go back, reload the page and try again.
Error_ImageInvalid: That image couldn't be read. Use a JPEG or PNG of up to 2048 pixels on each side.
Error_LastPasskey: You can't remove your last passkey while password sign-in is off.
Error_NeedPasskey: Add a passkey before turning password sign-in off.
Error_PasswordBreached: That password has appeared in a data breach. Choose another.
Error_PasswordLength: Use a password of 8 to 1024 characters.
Error_PasswordSignInOff: Signing in with a password is turned off. Use a passkey.
Error_RetentionRange: Data history must be between 1 week and 10 years (520 weeks).
Error_SignedOut: You've been signed out. Sign in and try again.
Error_TooLarge: That upload is too large. Choose an image under 8 MB.
Error_TooMany: Wait a few minutes, then try again.
Error_UsernameLength: Use a username of 1 to 64 characters.
Error_WrongRecoveryCode: That recovery code isn't right, has expired, or was already used.
Error_WrongSignIn: That username or password isn't right.
Footer_Tagline: Share your scores and activity with your friends, family, coaches, and trainers. Share only what you want to share.
Landing_GetTheApp: Don't have FitHalo yet? It's free!
Landing_InviteExpired: This invite no longer works. Ask the board's admin for a new one.
Landing_InvitePrivate: To join, ask a member or the board's admin for an invite.
Landing_NeedsPassword: You'll also need the board's password, which the admin gives out.
Landing_NotAcceptingRequests: This board isn't taking new requests right now. Try again later, or ask the board's admin.
Landing_QRLabel: QR code that opens this invite in FitHalo
Landing_ScanPrompt: Scan this with your phone's camera to join this FitHalo Scoreboard.
Members_DeleteHint: Both deleting and blocking a member will delete all of their data. Deleted users can attempt to join the Scoreboard again. Blocked users will be prevented from joining again.
Notice_BoardPasswordRemoved: The board no longer has a password.
Notice_InviteReplaced: The invite has been replaced. Old invite links and codes no longer work.
Notice_MemberLimitReached: This board has reached its limit of 1,000 members and is not accepting new members. Delete members to make room.
Notice_Recovered: Your new password is set. Sign in with it.
Password_BreachError: Couldn't reach Have I Been Pwned, so this password wasn't checked
Password_BreachFound: Found in a data breach. Choose another password.
Password_BreachNote: Passwords are checked against Have I Been Pwned's list of breached passwords. Your password is never transmitted when performing this check.
Password_BreachWaiting: Waiting to check against breach corpora
Password_RuleTooLong: Password must be at most 1024 characters
Password_RuleTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters
Recover_Intro: Getting back in needs access to the server itself. Run fithalo-scoreboard reset-admin on its host, or set SCOREBOARD_RECOVERY_CODE in its configuration, then enter that code here.
Recover_PasskeysRemoved: Every passkey is removed, since a lost device may hold one. Add them again once you're in.
Rules_JoinApproval: Members must be approved by the Administrator
Rules_MaximumHint: These options set what users are allowed to share. Members may always choose to share less data than this. Removing or lowering an option here will delete any relevant data from the FitHalo Scoreboard server.
Rules_MaximumPendingHint: Once you reach this number of pending membership requests, new requests will be denied until you approve or decline prior requests. Valid values are between 1 and 999.
Rules_PasswordHint: An additional password members will need to request to join the scoreboard. Give this password out in person, separate from the invite code.
Rules_WeekStartHint: Changing the weekly challenge start day will erase all score history.
Setup_BoardNameHelp: This will be the title of your FitHalo Scoreboard and will appear on your invite page as well as in the FitHalo apps when members join the scoreboard.
Setup_Intro: Name your FitHalo Scoreboard and create your administrator account.
Setup_WhereIntro: FitHalo Scoreboard creates a unique setup code the first time it starts. This code was printed to the console when FitHalo Scoreboard was launched.
SignIn_PasskeyFailed: That passkey could not sign you in.
Usage_Hint: Each weekly challenge may store up to 1 MB, including its routes. Sizes are counted before compression, so the board stores less.
Usage_Share: {percent}% of the limit for one weekly challenge
